tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Tile regrouting for walls and floors
Crumbling grout lines and missing grout between tiles
Tile regrouting for walls and floors

Missing or deteriorated grout can leave a tiled surface difficult to maintain. Ellis assesses the joints and surrounding tiles before agreeing regrouting for the affected wall or floor area. Loose tiles, movement or moisture damage may need separate repairs rather than simply new grout over the visible problem.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 缺失或劣化填缝让砖面难以保养。Ellis 先评估接缝与周边瓷砖，再确认墙地面填缝更新。松砖、位移或水损坏可能需独立维修，不能只在可见问题上覆新填缝。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We remove the included deteriorated grout, prepare the joints and install the agreed replacement material. The selected grout needs to suit the tile, joint and use of the space; we confirm the material and finish for the project rather than promise one product for every surface.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 去除约定的劣化填缝、准备接缝并安装替换材料。所选材料需适合瓷砖、接缝及空间用途，按项目确认材料和饰面，不承诺一种产品适合所有表面。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: For cracked or loose tiles, compare
Crumbling grout lines and missing grout between tiles

Regrouting is suitable for agreed joints where the surrounding tiles and base can support a joint repair. Cleaning may improve surface staining but does not replace missing material. We assess the depth and condition of deteriorated joints before agreeing removal and replacement. Loose tiles or repeated cracking can indicate movement that needs a different repair scope.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 周边瓷砖和基层支持接缝维修时，可更新约定填缝。清洁可改善表面污渍，但不能补回缺失材料。我们检查劣化接缝深度状况，再确认去除更换。松砖或反复开裂可能提示位移，需要其他范围维修。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Epoxy versus cement grout and flexible junctions
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 环氧与水泥填缝及柔性交接

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Epoxy and cement grout have different application, cleaning and suitability requirements. We consider the tile, joint width and exposure before confirming the material; epoxy grout does not replace waterproofing beneath the tiles. Flexible silicone belongs at the agreed movement junctions rather than being treated as ordinary grout. General wall and floor regrouting is separate from the shower-specific joint and silicone service.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 环氧与水泥填缝在施工、清洁和适用性方面要求不同。确认材料前考虑瓷砖、缝宽及暴露条件；环氧填缝不能替代砖下防水。约定伸缩交接处使用柔性硅胶，不当作普通砖缝。一般墙地面填缝更新，与淋浴专门的接缝及硅胶服务不同。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Tell us where grout is missing or crumbling and whether tiles are loose or cracks recur. Photos can help but are optional.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 说明填缝缺失或粉化位置，以及有无松砖或反复裂缝。照片可帮助评估，但为选填。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We agree which grout lines need renewal and separate them from flexible silicone junctions.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 确认需更新的填缝线，并与柔性硅胶交接区分。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Cement-based and epoxy grout renewal for tiled surfaces
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 墙地砖缝的水泥基与环氧填缝更新

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: We remove failed grout from existing ceramic and porcelain tile joints and prepare the gaps for renewal. Cement-based grout and epoxy grout offer different application and care characteristics. We discuss the tile surface, joint width, colour and cleaning conditions before specifying the replacement, especially around textured finishes and small mosaic joints.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 我们清除现有陶瓷与瓷质砖缝内失效填缝料，处理缝隙后重新填缝。水泥基与环氧填缝材料的施工和养护特点不同；选材前结合砖面、缝宽、颜色与清洁环境，尤其注意纹理砖和细小马赛克砖缝。

tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Regrouting renews the material between tiles; silicone replacement renews flexible junctions such as corners and changes of plane. We keep those functions separate and explain which joints the quote covers. Tell us whether the grout is missing, crumbling or difficult to clean, and which rooms need attention.
tile-regrouting-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 重新填缝更新砖与砖之间的材料；硅胶更换则处理墙角、平面变化等柔性连接。两类接缝分别安排，并在报价中说明范围。告诉我们砖缝是缺失、粉化还是难以清洁，以及需要处理的房间即可。
